stories.title: Among Us Story: On Guard gets a February 2027 release date
paragraphs: Innersloth set Among Us Story: On Guard for February 17, 2027. The standalone detective adventure is planned for PC, mobile, Nintendo Switch, and Switch 2.

Players take the role of Guard during a crew training simulation, investigate a murder, and collect clues while completing tasks. The public announcement thread included eager reactions and questions about its platforms and price; it does not establish wider demand.

scoreNotes.general: A fresh, concrete date for a recognizable game property, with a distinct single-player format and some immediate fan discussion.
scoreNotes.heat: Among Us remains a familiar indie-game property, and the release-date post drew a visible thread of excited and curious comments; no broad audience figures were reported.
scoreNotes.time: The February 17, 2027 date was announced October 9, inside the current window.
scoreNotes.ethos: A gaming publication reports the date, platforms, and premise; a public r/AmongUs thread repeats the date and samples fan response.

nearMisses.title: Machinarium 2 reunites the robot adventure's original creative team
nearMisses.reason: Yesterday's Triple-i showcase story already mentioned the sequel reveal. This interview adds development and design context, but today's review found no distinct new announcement or renewed attention to justify a main-story repeat.

scoreNotes.general: A notable return for a long-running indie adventure, with useful creator comments but limited evidence of a fresh audience spike.
scoreNotes.heat: The original has a dedicated audience and the sequel is a prominent indie reveal, but no current sales, wishlist, or viewership signal was visible.
scoreNotes.time: PC Gamer published the interview October 8, around the reveal already included in yesterday's edition.
scoreNotes.ethos: The report quotes Amanita Design's CEO and composer and describes the announced setting and cooperative puzzle design; no release date has been set.

paragraphs: Amanita Design is making Machinarium 2, bringing back Josef and Berta for a point-and-click puzzle adventure in a valley shared by two robot communities. Both characters will be playable and can be switched to solve puzzles together.
The studio's CEO said the team felt it was the right time to return to the world; composer Tomáš Dvořák is also back. The game has no release date.
